name: zinc finger CCCH-type, RNA binding motif and serine/arginine rich 2

function.text: ZRSR2 encodes a splicing factor important for recognition and processing of introns, particularly those handled by the minor spliceosome.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Somatic ZRSR2 mutations occur in myelodysplastic neoplasms and can disrupt splicing regulation. An isolated mutation does not independently establish an integrated myeloid diagnosis.
